calls.prompt: Use case: style-transfer / precise-object-edit. Edit target and binding reference: the provided original colored beer mug C-r01. Create the faithful BLACK AND WHITE simplified motif template MA-r01 for a monochrome nonogram, not the finished reveal. Preserve this exact mug's near-frontal view, upright silhouette, proportions, centered layout, large right-side handle and its spacious white inner opening, entire broad rounded glass base, organic foam crown lobes, and distinctive single foam spill extending down on the LEFT. Keep the mug in the same image position and same square framing; do not change angle, crop, tilt, add a stem, or substitute a different mug. Simplify as follows: turn the beer-filled main mug body and thick base into a single substantial SOLID BLACK shape; render the foam crown and the attached left drip WHITE, enclosed by a smooth strong black contour, about 35-45 image pixels thick at this image scale; preserve the actual foam silhouette and its relative height to the mug. Render the handle as a strong solid black rounded ring, preserving its outline and OPEN WHITE INTERIOR. Remove all tiny bubbles, condensation, shading, colors, textures, micro-contours, transparency reflections and decorative facets. Use at most two broad intentional vertical white highlight cutouts in the body, with generous thickness suitable for 28x32 cells, following the existing broad glass reflections; avoid thin stripes and any horizontal white stripe separating the base. Pure black ink on a plain PURE WHITE opaque background. All structural outlines strong and continuous; all main shapes readily readable at low resolution. Clean hand-drawn 2D contour character but no ragged sketching or intermediate grey textures. Do NOT draw a grid, cells, pixel art, numbers, words, frame, text, label or watermark. This is a smooth source illustration to be rasterized later, so NO actual pixel matrix. Single image only.
